title: Chocolate-Candy Corn Pretzel Bites
description: This 3-ingredient recipe will surely become a favorite fall treat. The salty-sweet bites are super tasty and look adorable.
ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) package pretzel snaps (square waffle-shaped pretzels)
1 (10 ounce) bag chocolate candies (such as Hershey®'s Hugs®)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange the pretzels in a single layer on the tray. Place a single Hersey's Hug on the center of each pretzel.
Bake until hugs start to melt slightly, 4 to 5 minutes. You want the chocolate candies to be soft but not entirely melted.
Remove from the oven and quickly place a candy corn on top of each hug, pressing down to secure in the chocolate. Move to the fridge to cool for about 30 minutes.

video.description: This 3-ingredient recipe has been a favorite fall treat for years — the hardest past is just unwrapping the hugs! In this video, Annie shows you how to make Chocolate-Candy Corn Pretzel Bites with those square waffle-shaped pretzels, chocolate candies (such as Hershey's Hugs), and candy corn. These salty-sweet bites look cute and creative with very little effort, plus the combination of chewy and crunchy textures makes them absolutely irresistible. Annie even says this is the only way she'll eat candy corn!
